description: This file defines an abstract base controller class for the installer process within the OrangeHRM system. It manages HTTP responses, enforces access controls based on installation status, and provides structure for handling installer-specific requests.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerController
classes.description: An abstract base class for installer controllers that manages HTTP responses and request handling during the installation process.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of Response.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the current response object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, ensuring it is of an allowed type or null.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for handling requests; checks installation status and delegates to abstract execute method.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to handle specific installer actions.
